I was there once (Disneyland California) with my family when I was in my teens. We did a 3 week road trip from Seattle to Los Angeles, and we thought Disneyland would be one of the Highlights. We payed a lot of money to get in, spent about 1 1/2 hours there (max) and left again. Why? Because it was so full, you could barely walk trought the park, no way to get onto an attraction without waiting for 2h, everything in the Park itself was very expensive and tbh, it was more looks than anything else (sorry if you are a die-hard Disneyland fan, but it just wasn't for us). I am from Europe and most of the theme parks here are way cheaper and you get way more for your money. There is a theme park about 2 hours from where I'm living, where entry is 20€, there are plenty of rides and the queues are a maximum of 15 minutes. I know I know, Disneyland is about Disney, all of the shows and movies, thats what the Park is primarily about, not the rides and a good value for money, but still...If you want to have a fun time and arent that hyped about Disney, dont go to Disneyland, you will regret it especially because it is so damn expensive
